profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a veteran developer with experience in mobile and web. I've worked for various startups, ad agencies, video game companies and design firms. For more information, please visit my website at http://www.geoffsdavis.net.

Code is a way to bring creative works to life, giving them animation and interactivity. That’s what I enjoy most.

Skills: 
iOS (Objective-C, Cocoa Touch, Swift), Android (Kotlin, Java), HTML5, AngularJS, NodeJS, MongoDB, PHP, MySQL.

Swift is awesome. I'm a fanboy. I'm using it in my personal projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on iOS apps...and now, Android.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Built prototype iOS companion app to enhance gameplay experience on PlayStation 4. Worked as part of small team on a Web-based game manual publishing tool, allowing PS4 manuals to be created digitally and displayed on either Web or mobile. Technologies used included HTML5, AngularJS, NodeJS, and MongoDB. As part of two-man team, also architected and built a Flash-based game manual system that played manuals as SWFs on the PlayStation 3.

positions.title: Sr. Flash Developer
positions.description: Wrote code for MTV Network’s Flash-based SDK used by game developers, which provided developers with back-end services such as saving game state, highscores, and player information. Wrote FlexUnit integration tests for testing asynchronous back-end services. Wrote Ant scripts to automate Flash builds and ASDoc code documentation.

positions.title: Flash & Flex Developer
positions.description: For SF ad agency Eveo, created ActionScript code library for tracking user interactions in Flex apps running on tradeshow kiosks. Made extensive use of PureMVC framework. Built Flex apps to project specs starting from Photoshop comps and wireframes. Worked in highly collaborative environment with multiple developers, art directors and QA personnel. Used Maven for automated builds.

positions.title: Flex Developer
positions.description: Solely responsible for creating and maintaining Flex-based SWF widgets for company's sports team clients, including L.A. Lakers and Utah Jazz. Widgets interacted with Java back-end through BlazeDS remote services to retrieve content and track user interaction. Wrote custom ActionScript class library shared across all widgets, designed for extension and reusability. Widgets used HTML wrapper to obtain team ID, then dynamically skinned themselves with content from database, allowing a single SWF file to be used across all teams. Widgets stored and managed user account information and login status in Flash Player LSOs on user's machine. Widgets could be shared by user on social network platforms such as Facebook, MySpace and iGoogle.

positions.title: Flash developer
positions.description: Created banner ads and microsites for clients including Yahoo and Sony.

positions.title: Flash developer
positions.description: Was part of development team for Verizon’s Flash-based Surround microsite.

positions.title: Interactive Developer & Production Artist
positions.description: Developed various in-house Web-based apps using PHP & MySQL, including an app used to manage Schwab's form letters. Proposed and developed productivity-enhancement scripts using PHP, Perl and AppleScript. Also wrote custom PHP scripts for converting XSD schemas to XML. Produced banner ads, jump pages, and other collateral using Photoshop and Flash.

positions.title: Designer & Developer
positions.description: Designed and produced litigation graphics for various agencies. Built a dynamic PHP-based e-commerce site from the ground up for Webster Buchanan Research, an HR analysis firm. Produced Flash banner ads for advertising agencies Grey Direct and Publicis Dialog. Taught classes in Photoshop and Illustrator for HighSoft, an Adobe software reseller.
